result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits: CGL at $1M/$2M, E&O at $2M, cyber/privacy at $5M for processing Licensee data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. It preserves the unrelated representation-by-counsel provision and is professionally drafted. However, requiring every coverage to continue for one year after termination, and extending cyber coverage expressly to all Confidential Information, goes beyond the playbook and is not necessary to reach the required position.
